name: trip-agent-mcp
description: Checks a trip for gaps and exports it as a calendar file on your computer.
long_description: Your own Claude reads your booking emails with your own email connector and assembles the trip. Trip Agent finds what is missing (an unbooked night, a journey that does not connect, a missing return) and writes the trip as a calendar (.ics) file on your computer, with the gaps as placeholders until you fix them. It reads no email, keeps no trips, and never writes passport, card, e-ticket or loyalty numbers.

tools.name: get_trip_file_info
tools.description: Say whether a trip's calendar file exists, and where the last mailbox search stopped.

tools.name: check_trip
tools.description: Check a trip for an unbooked night, a broken location chain or a missing return.

tools.name: export_trip
tools.description: Write the trip as a calendar (.ics) file on your computer.

tools.name: open_trip_file
tools.description: Open the exported calendar file in your default calendar app.

export_folder.title: Export folder
export_folder.description: Where the calendar files are written. Leave it blank to use Documents/trip-agent in your home folder.
